text:
State of the particle  
|ψ〉 = a|↑〉 + b|↓〉 ,   with a = 0.5 and b = √3/2 ≈ 0.866.  
( |a|² = 0.25, |b|² = 0.75, so the state is normalized.)

We want 〈ψ| (10 σ_z + 5 σ_x) |ψ〉 = 10 〈σ_z〉 + 5 〈σ_x〉.

1. Expectation value of σ_z  
   σ_z|↑〉 = +|↑〉 , σ_z|↓〉 = –|↓〉  
   〈σ_z〉 = 〈ψ|σ_z|ψ〉  
           = |a|² − |b|²  
           = 0.25 − 0.75  
           = −0.50.

2. Expectation value of σ_x  
   σ_x|↑〉 = |↓〉 , σ_x|↓〉 = |↑〉  
   σ_x|ψ〉 = a|↓〉 + b|↑〉  
   〈σ_x〉 = (a⟨↑| + b⟨↓|)(a|↓〉 + b|↑〉)  
           = a b + b a  
           = 2ab  
           = 2(0.5)(0.866)  
           ≈ 0.866.

3. Combine the two parts  
   〈10 σ_z + 5 σ_x〉 = 10(−0.50) + 5(0.866)  
                     = −5.0 + 4.33  
                     ≈ −0.67.

Rounded to one decimal place: −0.7.

Option (A) matches this result.

Answer: A
